newsitem.title: FRANCE: Bomb death toll rises to 21 in Algiers market.
newsitem.headline: Bomb death toll rises to 21 in Algiers market.

text.p: A bomb exploded in a crowded weekly market in Algiers on Monday, killing 21 people and wounding about 40, Algerian state-run radio said, quoting a security forces statement.
Earlier in a statement carried on the official news agency APS, the security forces said the bomb, in the southern Algiers suburb of Baraki, had killed at least 11 people and wounded 40.
